rationale: Price is at 90.2% of today's range near the session high after a strong gap-up, but the last five 1-minute candles show clear deceleration and a mild rollover (from 14.47 down to 14.39) with volume picking up on the down bars — suggesting exhaustion rather than continuation. No edge is clearly present in either direction.
